name: Orbital Economy v7.6.1 — Mode 25 calibration change contract r1.1
description: Written before the candidate was built. Accepted baseline: v7.6 r2. The only authorised change is the value of Power Resource Shock Factor (0.1 -> 0.5), which acts only in Mode 25; every other Mode must reproduce v7.6 r2 exactly. Model name and descriptions are not semantic and produce no events. Rationale: docs/V7_6_1_CALIBRATION_REPORT.md. r1.1 (after the first CHECK_CANDIDATE run): the changed constant is itself an output series, so its own series changes in every Mode; rule factor-series allows exactly that one series everywhere and is placed before the regression guard. No other rule changed.

rules.name: Power Resource Shock Factor
rules.note: r1.1: a VARIABLE constant is also an output series; its value 0.1 -> 0.5 shows in all 27 Modes. This is the authorised change itself, not a behavioural difference.
Any numerical change outside Mode 25 is forbidden (first match wins).

rules.name: A Power Resource Extraction Multiplier
rules.note: Proves the new value reaches the model.
The shock is milder, so Mode 25 outputs change; that is the purpose.
